'''James Yarrington''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[November 2000 Roanoke tournament]] on 5 November 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|TDIGWATT]], according to Gordon Marx's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1438">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-08-gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00d1438/ gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00], DeckTech (Gordon "Tallus" Marx, 8 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-08-gordons-roanoke-tr-11-5-00d1438/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
